command: set -e; adb start-server >/dev/null; DEVICES=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); test "$DEVICES" = "RFCT70L7E8J"; MODEL=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell pm path link.localclimate.app >/dev/null; echo PHONE_OK=$MODEL; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=' | head -4
